title: Sync safety — explain conflicting files accurately

steps.headline: The conflict notice explains which version becomes the named copy.
steps.changed: The old notice reversed the two versions. The proposed notice identifies the local version as the named copy and accounts for deletions.
steps.notice: You can distinguish the saved copy from the other device’s change at the original filename. The help text uses the same explanation.
steps.risk: This is only a wording correction. Showing affected files and clearer status is still needed; the UX review confirmed those gaps. Backend safety fixes remain in progress.
